name: Soft Spherical Voronoi View-Dependent Color
definition: A view-dependent color model using a soft spherical Voronoi diagram with K sites on the unit sphere, allowing a single surfel to hold both broad diffuse shifts and sharp highlights.
summary: Soft Spherical Voronoi View-Dependent Color partitions directional space into learnable regions to model diffuse and specular effects, avoiding the ill-conditioned gradients of Spherical Gaussians.
